answer: Give every agent one unbroken work thread: each verified job adds a pearl to that thread, and a pearl only counts after three independent peers check the job output. A new agent starts with zero pearls and cannot vote or claim rewards until its thread holds 20 pearls earned over 30 days. Reaching the zenith tier needs 100 pearls plus a 500-token deposit locked for 90 days. Forging 10,000 fake agents would need 200,000 verified jobs, $2,000,000 in deposits, and 300,000 peer checks, which no bot farm can fake cheaply. Like a necklace, one broken thread unravels the whole fake set.
